event: The Tel Aviv War contributes to a global energy crisis. Operation Sand Viper becomes the origin story for the Ghosts name.
Venezuela, Brazil and Chile unite under the Federation of the Americas and grow into a major power during the energy crisis.
Operation Return to Sender: the Ghosts kill Diego Almagro in Caracas. Elias is forced to leave Rorke behind; Rorke is later captured and turned by the Federation.
Federation forces hijack ODIN and launch kinetic strikes against U.S. cities before the station is destroyed.
The Federation War settles into a ten-year stalemate while the United States fortifies surviving territory.
Logan, Hesh and Riley defend the Liberty Wall and receive orders from Elias.
The brothers enter No Man's Land, discover Rorke's involvement and attempt to rescue Ajax.
Fort Santa Monica is attacked by the Federation.
Ghosts infiltrate Caracas and interrogate Victor Ramos.
Ghosts capture Rorke in the Gulf of Mexico.
Rorke escapes after a Federation attack destroys the Ghosts' transport plane over Yucatán.
Clockwork operation steals Federation data from a base in the Andes.
The Atlas oil platform is destroyed.
Ghosts destroy a Federation naval weapon and uncover the Federation's orbital-weapon plan.
Rorke kills Elias at the Las Vegas safehouse.
The United States launches its final counteroffensive, captures LOKI, attacks Federation targets, and Logan/Hesh strike Rorke's train. Rorke survives and captures Logan.
Nightfall takes place at the Alaska facility, 14 weeks after the Colorado outbreak.
Awakening occurs beneath Ball's Pyramid, 36 hours after Mayday.
Exodus culminates with the Medusa Device and an evacuation attempt while CIF Team 1 holds back the Cryptid threat.
